verdict.rationale: Context.dev is documented only as a hosted web data API, reached through SDKs, a CLI, and an MCP endpoint. Nothing in the evidence describes a Docker image, a self-hosted deployment, or any way to run the scraping service on your own infrastructure. Self-hosting is a fair question for a scraping service, so the axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy the scraping service via a Docker container for production use
